fabricroadmap.title: Fabric OneLake catalog in Excel Get Data
fabricroadmap.summary: The OneLake catalog integration in Excel as part of modern Get Data unlocks seamless connectivity to Fabric data, empowering every business user to discover and analyze organizational content directly from Excel. fabricroadmap.title: Fabric OneLake catalog - Copilot for automatic description

fabricroadmap.title: OneLake catalog - Automatic description with Copilot for Semantic models
fabricroadmap.summary: Auto-Description uses Copilot to generate clear, relevant descriptions for semantic models in the OneLake catalog.Item owners can quickly review, refine, and publish these descriptions to save time and improve discoverability, search relevance, and overall understanding of each model.

fabricroadmap.title: OneLake Catalog - govern with centralized management capabilities (domains, tags, capacities, etc)
fabricroadmap.summary: The OneLake Catalog – Govern experience is expanding by introducing a comprehensive set of management tools designed to reduce fragmentation and simplify day-to-day administration. fabricroadmap.title: Find Fabric items and tables from Copilot CLI with OneLake Catalog
fabricroadmap.summary: As part of Skills for Fabric, AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot can discover Fabric items and tables. fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Materialized Lake Views - Multiple Schedule Support
fabricroadmap.summary: Multiple schedule in FMLV allows users to independently schedule refreshes for individual Materialized Lake Views or chains within a Lakehouse, rather than applying a single schedule to the entire LakeHouse. fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Materialized Lake Views - Multi Workspace/Lakehouse execution support
fabricroadmap.summary: Multi Lakehouse support in Lineage enables users to visualize and manage dependencies of Materialized Lake Views (MLVs) across multiple workspaces and lakehouses, providing a unified view that helps prevent data silos and improves transparency. fabricroadmap.title: Lakehouse Query Window
fabricroadmap.summary: On the data exploration front, the new Lakehouse Query Explorer introduces a streamlined, in-context query experience directly within the Lakehouse. fabricroadmap.summary: OneLake is adding support for multi-table Row-Level Security (RLS) to OneLake security. fabricroadmap.title: Custom Live Pools

fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Release Channel - Public Preview

fabricroadmap.title: Fabric Spark - JDBC Drivers - Public Preview
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature provides the Spark JDBC driver as a downloadable component for use within client applications. It enables those applications to connect to Fabric or Synapse Spark and execute Spark jobs seamlessly.

fabricroadmap.title: Agentic Copilot for Notebooks

fabricroadmap.title: Environment - Lightweight Library management

fabricroadmap.title: Notebooks integration with Data source management

fabricroadmap.title: VSCode FabricNotebook Agent mode

fabricroadmap.title: Environment - Support for Python Notebook

fabricroadmap.title: Spark Workspace Monitoring v1

fabricroadmap.title: Track and Manage Notebook Run Dependencies & Linage View
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature delivers a comprehensive Notebook Run Lineage experience for Spark applications, enabling data engineers to monitor and analyze complex notebook workflows with ease. fabricroadmap.title: Spark Diagnostic Emitter for Spark 4.1

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Performance: Disable V-Order Compression
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2 will introduce a new preview capability that allows customers to disable V‑Order (VertiParquet) compression for supported workloads and destinations, giving advanced users greater control over execution behavior, performance characteristics, and cost trade‑offs.This capability is especially valuable for scenarios where write latency and refresh throughput are prioritized over downstream storage optimization. fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Lakehouse Maintenance Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Lakehouses are at the core of success of your cloud analytics with Microsoft Fabric. Now with Lakehouse Maintenance Activities in pipelines, you can automate common important administrative operations including optimize and vacuum.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Support added for schedule parameters
fabricroadmap.summary: Hyper-parametrization in Data Factory pipelines enables powerful reusable generic patterns and is very popular in Data Factory. Now with parameter support in schedules you can create schedules that have specific parameter values to create complex execution patterns.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Support Workspace Monitoring
fabricroadmap.summary: With Workspace Monitoring for Copy Job, you can collect and organize logs and metrics from all Copy Job runs in an Eventhouse database within your workspace. You can also query this database to gain insights into workspace usage and performance, including the performance of individual Copy Jobs.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Oracle
fabricroadmap.summary: With the CDC mechanism, customers can automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from Oracle Database and replicate them to the destination—without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - SAP with ABAP add-on
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job for SAP with ABAP add-on enables organizations to bring SAP data into Microsoft Fabric using a Microsoft Data Integration ABAP Add-On installed on the SAP server. It extends Fabric’s built-in SAP connectors and supports copying tables, views, and CDS views from supported SAP systems with both full and incremental copy modes.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication to Oracle
fabricroadmap.summary: Customers can use Copy job to automatically capture inserts, updates, and deletions from any supported CDC source store, and replicate them to the new destination stores including Oracle without requiring a watermark column.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC replication with full history tracking (SCD2)
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy Job supports CDC-based replication with SCD2 patterns. It captures incremental changes including inserts, updates, and deletions from the source system using Change Data Capture (CDC) and applies them to the target table while preserving full historical records.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Tumbling Window Triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: In ADF & Synapse, tumbling window triggers are very popular mechanism by which you can automate your pipelines using non-overlapping time slices that you can manage and rerun. We are bringing this powerful scheduling technique to Fabric through "interval-based schedules" in the Fabric scheduler.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Data Pipeline Tumbling Window Triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: Scheduling pipeline runs using time windows that are non-overlapping and can be "replayed" is a very important feature in pipelines that many ADF users have enjoyed using. We are super excited to bring this tumbling window feature to Data Pipeline scheduling in Fabric Data Factory.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - SSIS lift & shift in Fabric Data Factory
fabricroadmap.summary: Public Preview: Q1 2026

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Support pipeline parameters in schedules
fabricroadmap.summary: Pipelines in Fabric Data Factory emphasize general re-use patterns and metadata driven methodologies. Now with support for pipeline parameters in schedules you can create multiple schedules per pipeline with different parameter values enabling incredibly powerful generic pipeline workflow patterns.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Set the "Run As" identity of the pipeline from the pipeline schedule
fabricroadmap.summary: When automating your Fabric Data Factory pipelines, you will greatly benefit from having the flexibility to set the identity (i.e. user, SPN, workspace identity) of the pipeine at the time of execution. With this feature, you can now set it easily from the scheduler API and scheduler UI.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Workspace Monitoring to include Apache Airflow logs from Airflow Job
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Apache Airflow jobs provides a SaaS way to build Python-based Airflow DAGs in your Fabric workspace. With this new feature, you will now be able to easily view your runtime logs from Apache Airflow in the Fabric Workspace Monitoring view to build your own queries, reports, and dashboards.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Auto-enable CDF on Delta table creation from Copy job
fabricroadmap.summary: Change Data Feed can be automatically enabled for Delta tables created by Copy job, allowing downstream workloads to directly leverage the Delta Change Data Feed to track all data changes.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Activator support for triggering Copy jobs
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Activator can trigger Copy job executions in a native way, allowing event‑driven scenarios without pipeline where a file landing in storage automatically initiates a Copy job.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from Salesforce
fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job provides a Salesforce CDC connector, allowing you to capture row‑level inserts, updates, and deletes from Salesforce and replicate them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from PostgreSQL
fabricroadmap.summary: With the PostgreSQL CDC connector in Copy job, you can capture inserts, updates, and deletes from PostgreSQL and copy them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - CDC based replication from MySQL
fabricroadmap.summary: With the MySQL CDC connector in Copy job, you can capture inserts, updates, and deletes from MySQL and copy them to any supported destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job - Support composite watermark columns for incremental copy
fabricroadmap.summary: Incremental copy from Copy job will support composite watermark columns for complex change detection, including scenarios where the maximum watermark is derived from multiple incremental columns such as LastCreateDateTime and LastModifiedDateTime together.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job/Activity - Improve read performance for Parquet format when source is a single large file
fabricroadmap.summary: Improve the read performance when reading a single large parquet file in Copy job and Pipeline activities (Copy activity, Lookup activity, GetMetadata activity, Delete activity) by allowing multi-threads.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - SAP Datasphere
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring delivers a no-ETL, near real-time integration of your SAP data into Microsoft Fabric. Using SAP Datasphere, you can continuously replicate data from SAP systems directly into Fabric OneLake without disrupting transactional performance. This approach ensures your SAP data seamlessly blends with the rest of your enterprise data in Fabric, enabling unified analytics and insights at scale.

fabricroadmap.title: Security - Workspace Data Exfiltration Protection (DEP)
fabricroadmap.summary: Dataflow Gen2, Pipeline, Copy Job will support Workspace DEP also reffered as "Outbound Access Protection".

fabricroadmap.title: Gateways - Autoscaling gateway clusters for VNet Gateway
fabricroadmap.summary: For VNet data gateways, the fixed node setup can be inefficient during high-demand periods. To improve this, we're introducing auto-scaling, which dynamically adjusts the number of nodes based on demand.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Enhanced Connection Collaboration Model
fabricroadmap.summary: To enhance security, we aim to prevent the sharing of Microsoft account credentials across collaborators. The new connection-sharing model will encourage each collaborator to sign in with their own Microsoft account.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Browse SharePoint UX
fabricroadmap.summary: One of the biggest challenges over the years for Citizen Users in connecting to data stored in SharePoint (Files, Folders, Lists) has been to specify the right SharePoint URL to connect to. We’re planning to provide a “Browse SharePoint” UX, similar to the existing “Browse OneDrive” UX in product, that will allow customers to explore the SharePoint Sites available to them – This enhancement is planned to ship across Modern Get Data (for SharePoint Folder and SharePoint Lists) as well as Output Destinations (SharePoint output destination).

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Recents in Modern Get Data
fabricroadmap.summary: Support users to quickly reconnect to their recently used tables or raw data sources within the Modern Get Data experience, saving them from having to specify data source and connection details again.

fabricroadmap.title: Connectors - Oracle Connector support without requiring a gateway
fabricroadmap.summary: Oracle connector supports cloud-based scenario by bundling the Oracle Data Provider NET driver and avoiding users having to use an On-premises data gateway for Cloud-only scenarios.

fabricroadmap.title: Copy job -  Change Data Capture (CDC) capability GA with SQL estates
fabricroadmap.summary: The Change Data Capture (CDC) capability in Copy Job is generally available with Azure SQL DB, SQL Server and SQL MI

fabricroadmap.title: Copy Job - Audit Column
fabricroadmap.summary: You can use Copy job to add audit-style system columns when moving data to your destination, improving data lineage and compliance. This feature provides row-level visibility into your destination data, showing when rows were moved and where they came from, enabling downstream data lineage tracking and compliance reporting across the entire stack.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Enabling Delta Change Feed
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring supports delta change feed that enables fine grain tracking of changes of delta tables to be consumed by downstream applications.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Support for replication of Views from Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirroring will support replicating views from source databases.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Run Pipeline when dependencies are met
fabricroadmap.summary: A commonly used functionality in ADF is configuring a Pipeline to run when a set of dependencies are met. We are excited to bring this functionality to Data Pipelines in Data Factory in Fabric to continue enriching orchestration capabilities.

fabricroadmap.title: Connections - Tenant Admin APIs for connections
fabricroadmap.summary: New tenant admin REST APIs for end-to-end visibility and lifecycle management of all cloud connections in Microsoft Fabric — list, get, delete, manage permissions/ take over.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Support for Apache Airflow 3.x
fabricroadmap.summary: Microsoft Fabric Apache Airflow Jobs provided the easiest and quickest way to build enterprise-ready DAGs without any infrastructure requirements. They are based on open-source Apache Airflow and we have now updated our support to version 3.3 of Apache Airflow.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Actions
fabricroadmap.summary: With pipeline actions, we are extending the reach and re-usability of pipelines in Fabric Data Factory. Now you can take portions of your complex pipelines, a single activity, or even your entire pipeline, and register it as a Fabric Action. That Fabric Action is now fully accessible via endpoints in other pipelines, Data Activator, or UDFs.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Pipeline Dependencies
fabricroadmap.summary: When automating pipeline execution across complex data ecosystems, it is very important to only invoke those pipelines when specific requirements have first been met. In Fabric Data Factory, we refer to these as "pipeine dependencies". With this new feature, you will be able to set independent rules for each pipeline that requires data presences, trigger status, and pipeline status as optional depedency parameters for your pipeline runs.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Simplified Upgrade Experience
fabricroadmap.summary: In order to gain productivity boosts with AI in Fabric Data Factory, you can now easily upgrade your existing ADF factories to Fabric in a super easy friction-free way. Previously we had multi-step processes that were run from button clicks in ADF. Now your existing ADF factories can be automatically bridged from Fabric trial capacities and then easily upgraded as-is to native Fabric pipelines and data flows.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Pipeline Dependencies
fabricroadmap.summary: When building workflows with pipelines in Fabric Data Factory, it is very important to express rules that allow you to tell the workflow engine which conditions must be met before invoking or continuing your logic. In pipelines in Data Factory, we are super happy to announce that we've brought this capability into Fabric. If you are a user of ADF and Synpase, this feature was previously available as "trigger dependencies" inside of tumbling window triggers. fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Approvals Activity
fabricroadmap.summary: We've enabled a key new capability in Data Factory pipelines in Fabric that extends the use of pipelines beyond just data integration and ETL. Now you can create powerful business workflows with pipelines with our new approval activity that allows you to gate the execution of your pipeline by setting an approver.

fabricroadmap.title: Pipelines - Workspace Identity support for pipeline activities
fabricroadmap.summary: With support for Fabric Workspace Identity (WI), you can now use WI authentication in your pipeline activities. This enables secure and reliable authentication to run automated pipelines using secured identities.

fabricroadmap.title: Airflow - Network Security
fabricroadmap.summary: Network security is critical to running an effective and secured Apache Airflow environment. We are excited to bring Vnet and Private Link support to Apache Airflow jobs in Fabric Data Factory.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - My Queries
fabricroadmap.summary: My Queries in Dataflow Gen2 will become available in Preview, enabling users to save commonly used Power Query transformations to a personal library and reuse them across multiple dataflows.This preview introduces a reuse‑first authoring model, making it easy to apply proven logic—such as data cleansing steps, business rules, or standard joins—without rebuilding queries from scratch.Key benefits and scenarios: Reuse common transformation logic across multiple Dataflow Gen2 artifacts to speed up authoring Reduce duplication and promote more consistent data preparation patterns Accelerate creati

fabricroadmap.summary: Copy job for SAP with ABAP add-on enables organizations to bring SAP data into Microsoft Fabric using a Microsoft Data Integration ABAP Add-On installed on the SAP server. Each run writes a new, timestamped file or table into the destination the customer chose, so snapshots accumulate side by side instead of overwriting one another.This gives customers a durable record of what their data looked like at each point in time, which today they can only approximate by building a second dataflow, adding a downstream pipeline, or exporting results by hand. fabricroadmap.summary: Customers will be able to browse and connect to their Azure resources directly from the modern get data experience in Power Query, without leaving the product to look up connection details. fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - New Output Destination:  Snowflake
fabricroadmap.summary: We continue enhancing the options for Dataflow Gen2 creators to output their transformation results to the destinations they need. Snowflake databases are the top non-MSFT requested destination, and we aim to provide the ability to output query results to new or existing tables in Snowflake databases.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Schema Support in Dataflow Gen2 Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: One of the most requested enhancements to the Output Destinations experience over relational databases is having the ability to create new tables within specific schemas. We plan to enable this over destinations such as Lakehouse, Warehouse and SQL databases.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Parameter Support in Dataflow Gen2 Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Parameterized dataflows is a top area of customer feedback, and one of the most common use cases is to parameterize the Output Destination within a dataflow. We plan to support the ability to parameterize the container (database/artifact/folder), as well as the table within it to which the dataflow outputs data.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Merge/Upsert Support for Output Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: A commonly requested new capability for Output Destinations is the ability to merge, or upsert, data into previously loaded rows in the destination table. We aim to provide this support for Fabric Lakehouse destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Power Query - Modern Power Query Get Data in Power BI Desktop
fabricroadmap.summary: Modern Get Data offers highly intuitive methods for users to connect to their data from a wide range of data sources. By integrating Modern Get Data with Power BI Desktop, users will also be able to easily discover and consume data stored in Fabric via the OneLake Catalog which is now deeply integrated within the Modern Get Data experience. This Modern Get Data experience facilitates an efficient process for importing data into Power BI reports to enable self-service data analytics.

fabricroadmap.title: Gateways - On-premises data gateway auto-update
fabricroadmap.summary: The on-premises data gateway auto-upgrade feature ensures that the gateway always runs the latest version, providing improved functionality, security updates, and new features without manual intervention. This feature simplifies the management of the gateway by automatically downloading and installing updates as they become available.

fabricroadmap.title: Mirroring - Open Mirroring: Support for Non-Sequential Files
fabricroadmap.summary: Today in Open Mirroring we require users to upload their parquet and csv files in a sequence (000001.csv, 000002.csv, etc). We will add support for non-sequential files so customers have more flexibility when using the Open Mirroring API.

fabricroadmap.title: Power Query - Modern Power Query Editor in Power BI Desktop
fabricroadmap.summary: Power BI Desktop will adopt the Modern Power Query Editor, bringing next‑generation authoring, usability, and productivity enhancements that are not available in the legacy Power Query experience. fabricroadmap.title: dbt job - Support for dbt Fusion runtime in dbt job
fabricroadmap.summary: We are adding support dbt Fusion runtime in dbt job in Microsoft Fabric as an execution environment, in addition to the existing dbt Core–based runtime.Customers can select the Fusion runtime when creating or configuring a dbt job to run their transformations on the next-generation dbt engine — natively inside Fabric, with no local tooling or external orchestration to manage.

fabricroadmap.title: Dataflows - Shared Queries
fabricroadmap.summary: Shared Queries in Dataflow Gen2 will be available in Preview, enabling users to save commonly used Power Query transformations within a Fabric workspace, share and reuse them across multiple dataflows and collaborators.This preview extends the reuse‑first authoring model to teams, making it easy to apply trusted, reusable logic—such as data cleansing steps, business rules, or standard joins—consistently across projects without rebuilding queries from scratch.Key benefits and scenarios: Share common transformation logic across workspace members to accelerate team-wide development Promote consis

fabricroadmap.title: GA AutoML in Fabric
fabricroadmap.summary: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) enables users to build and deploy machine learning models by automating the most time-consuming and complex parts of the model development process. The General Availability will enable users to simplofy the ML development cycle by using AutoML to automatically select the best algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and generate optimized models based on the input data and desired outcomes.

fabricroadmap.title: Machine Learning Model Endpoint Monitoring
fabricroadmap.summary: After activating ML Model endpoints in Fabric, users will need to monitor the quality of their models and the health of their endpoints in the artifact UI with a corresponding set of dynamic graphs. With this feature released, users are able to see request rate, request error rate, and latency on ML model endpoint monitoring UI.

fabricroadmap.title: Multimodal Support for AI Functions [Public Preview]
fabricroadmap.summary: Multimodal support for AI functions in Fabric will allow notebook users to use AI functions on their unstructured data in pdf, image, and text file formats, to seamlessly perform tasks like summarization, classification, sentiment analysis, and more, with just a few lines of code. The multimodal support for AI functions will be available with both pandas and Spark.

fabricroadmap.title: Feature Store
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric feature store is a centralized system that manages the data inputs, called features, that power machine learning models. It bridges raw data and ML models, giving teams one place to define, store, serve, and discover features instead of each team building its own pipelines.

fabricroadmap.title: MLOps: model alias
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature is to offer a model alias that provides a stable, human‑readable name pointing to a specific model version. This lets them switch, promote, or roll back model versions safely without breaking downstream integrations.

fabricroadmap.title: Support tensor based models on model endpoints
fabricroadmap.summary: ML Endpoints are currently available for a limited set of ML model flavors, including Keras, LightGBM, Sklearn, and XGBoost. This feature allows users to activate ML endpoints for models with tensor-based schemas or no schemas.

fabricroadmap.title: Outbound Access Protection for ML Experiment
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature allow fabric enterprise customers to use ML experiments in Outbound Access Protection enabled workspace and prevent sensitive data from getting exfiltrated.

fabricroadmap.title: Outbound Access Protection for ML Model
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature enables Fabric enterprise customers to use ML models in Outbound Access Protection (OAP) enabled workspace and prevent sensitive data from getting exfiltrated.

fabricroadmap.title: MLFlow 3 in Fabric : logged model and traces
fabricroadmap.summary: MLflow 3 arrives in Fabric with support for tracing, logged models, and an upgraded experiment tracking UX. The update introduces a new trace table view and nested trace visualization for inspecting multi-step model execution paths, a dedicated trace detail page, and the logged model API and UX for capturing and managing model artifacts as first-class objects. Together, these provide a more structured workflow for tracking experiments, registering models, and understanding model behavior.

fabricroadmap.title: GA foundry tools in Fabric
fabricroadmap.summary: Formerly named Azure Cognitive Services, Foundry Tools on Fabric brings in Azure Language, Azure Translator, and Azure Content Understanding as native endpoints for both Fabric workload teams and end users. This update incorporates many of the latest updates we have made to reports and report theming. This update also includes increasing the default page size to 1080x1920. Report theme customizaton improvements such as color palettes and additional properties will be added during public preview.

fabricroadmap.title: Date picker slicer to set relative and manual date ranges
fabricroadmap.summary: Adds a date picker mode for date slicers so authors can pick a relative default range (e.g., “last full month”) that automatically rolls forward as time passes when published, without authors having to update the report each period. Report viewers can override it to filter to other relative ranges or any manual date range.

fabricroadmap.title: TMDL View in the Web
fabricroadmap.summary: We are bringing TMDL View in the web

fabricroadmap.title: DirectQuery support for editing semantic models in the Power BI service
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature brings DirectQuery (DQ) support to Power BI web modeling, enabling users to create and edit DirectQuery and Dual models directly in the browser. Today, DirectQuery authoring is only available in Power BI Desktop.

fabricroadmap.title: Translytical task flows
fabricroadmap.summary: With translytical task flows, you can automate end-user actions like updating records, adding annotations, or creating workflows that trigger actions. Simply add a button in your Power BI report and link it to your Fabric user data function.

fabricroadmap.title: Visual calculations GA
fabricroadmap.summary: A visual calculation is a DAX calculation that's defined and executed directly on a visual. Visual calculations make it easier to create calculations previously hard to create, right in the visual.

fabricroadmap.title: Org Apps GA
fabricroadmap.summary: Org Apps allows you to easily create different apps for different pruposes with full source control support. In this upcomming release we will close alot of the most requested features and take Org Apps to General Availability.

fabricroadmap.title: Narrative Visual Support in PaaS embed
fabricroadmap.summary: This new capability will support the Narrative Visual in PaaS report embedding

fabricroadmap.title: Developer Mode GA
fabricroadmap.summary: We will be GAing developer mode in Desktop which will include the new PBIR format being default on for everyone. More details to follow.

fabricroadmap.title: DAX User Defined Functions
fabricroadmap.summary: User-Defined Functions (UDFs) allow you to encapsulate reusable, parameterized DAX logic into named functions that can be called across measures, calculated columns, and visual calculations throughout your semantic model. UDFs support both value and expression parameters, enabling you to centralize complex business logic—like tax calculations or currency conversions—so it's written once and maintained in a single place. Functions can be created in DAX Query View or TMDL View and appear as first-class objects under a dedicated "Functions" node in Model Explorer

fabricroadmap.title: Enhanced Report Consumption Copilot with Fabric IQ
fabricroadmap.summary: Powered by Fabric IQ, this enhancement to Report Consumption Copilot improves answer quality by delivering more accurate and relevant responses to data questions, helping users better understand and explore report content through natural language.

fabricroadmap.title: Audience support in Org Apps
fabricroadmap.summary: This improvement to Power BI's Org Apps will add support for defining user access and content display by audience(s), like the functionality in Power BI workspace apps. Audiences will allow for conditional display of content in the org app according to the audience or audiences a user belongs to. For instance, app creators can create one audience that can see only a subset of report within the app, but another audience with managerial oversite to make use of all of the reporting.

fabricroadmap.title: Outbound access protection for Power BI (Reports)
fabricroadmap.summary: Workspace admins responsible for safeguarding organizational data will be able to leverage Outbound Access Control (OAP) in Fabric to ensure that Semantic Models and Power BI Reports are permitted to connect only to explicitly approved data sources. OAP helps to prevent data exfiltration by blocking data connections to unapproved or potentially risky endpoints, thereby enforcing organizational data governance and compliance requirements.

fabricroadmap.title: Set as landing page in Power BI reports
fabricroadmap.summary: Always make sure your report viewers land on the right page

fabricroadmap.title: Tooltip options for Power BI visuals
fabricroadmap.summary: Control which tooltips show and how the tooltips display on your visual

fabricroadmap.title: Shape map visual in Power BI reports
fabricroadmap.summary: Built-in shape map support coming with topojson, geojson, and URL support

fabricroadmap.title: Input slicer numeric support
fabricroadmap.summary: Input slicer to allow numeric data colors for filtering and forced numeric entry.

fabricroadmap.title: Conditional formatting for lines and series/labels in Power BI visuals
fabricroadmap.summary: Conditional formatting to be available for series in Power BI visuals. This includes lines, markers, and legends.

fabricroadmap.title: List slicer with dropdown mode
fabricroadmap.summary: List slicer with drop down mode and advanced search options.

fabricroadmap.title: Gantt chart visual
fabricroadmap.summary: A new core visual in Power BI -- the gantt chart, visualizing all your product tasks in a Power BI report.

fabricroadmap.title: Add to preset for Power BI visuals
fabricroadmap.summary: Take the formatting on an individual visual and add it to the custom report theme for re-use on other visuals in the same report or a new report.

fabricroadmap.title: Organizational themes for Power BI reports
fabricroadmap.summary: Organizational themes (preview) allow Power BI administrators to centrally manage and distribute custom report themes across the organization. Maintaining a consistent visual identity across Power BI reports is now simpler and more scalable, thanks to organizational themes. Whether reports are built manually or generated with Copilot, this feature ensures that styling and branding stay aligned with your organization's identity and design standards.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream reference data join with one lake delta tables
fabricroadmap.summary: The Reference Data Join feature in Eventstream enables you to enrich streaming events by joining them with static or slowly changing delta tables in one lake.User can reference any one lake delta tables using lakehouse, and join it with streaming data in eventstream to enahace and add additional context to their events during processing.

fabricroadmap.title: AzMonStream data format in Eventhouse
fabricroadmap.summary: Fabric Eventhouse now supports the [AzMonStream data format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/kusto/ingestion-supported-formats?view=microsoft-fabric).This data format allows you to ingest data emitted by Azure Monitor diagnostic settings sent to Azure Event Hub directly. No Update Policy are required to expend each record in the payload array: this is all taken care of by the data format!This data format will also soon be supported in the Get Data experience.

fabricroadmap.title: Azure Service Bus source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now provides a generally available Azure Service Bus source connector. Customers can bring messages from Service Bus queues and topics into Microsoft Fabric for real-time processing without custom code.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to Azure Service Bus queues and topics.- Route Service Bus data to Fabric destinations for analysis and alerts.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Connector: Oracle DB CDC
fabricroadmap.summary: The Oracle CDC connector for Eventstream captures database changes from Oracle Database and streams them into Eventstream for real-time processing and analysis.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Connector: MQTTv3
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now supports MQTT protocol versions v3 and v5, enabling you to connect to an MQTT broker, subscribe to specific topics, and stream data from those topics directly into Eventstream for real-time processing.

fabricroadmap.title: VNET/On-Prem support for Eventstream Connectors
fabricroadmap.summary: The Eventstream streaming connector in Fabric Real-Time Intelligence enables the ingestion of real-time data from various sources into Fabric. This VNET/On-Prem support feature extends the streaming source’s environment from public networks to private networks, such as cloud virtual networks or on-premises networks.

fabricroadmap.title: Real-Time hub left-navigation consolidation for Data Sources
fabricroadmap.summary: To improve clarity and task completion in Real Time hub, we’re streamlining the left navigation. Users have reported confusion due to multiple overlapping entry points, making it difficult to locate the right actions for their real-time data workflows. By consolidating and simplifying the left-navigation menu, we aim to reduce cognitive load and help users quickly identify the most relevant entry point for their tasks.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream to Activator Destination GA
fabricroadmap.summary: Activator can monitor and act on events ingested to Fabric through an Eventstream. This feature is to track GA of this destination.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream supports customers to upload own connector
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature enables customers to develop or reuse their own Kafka connectors, or open-source Kafka connectors, when no pre-built streaming connector is available.With this capability, you can:- Customize your own connector at your own pace.- Run with no infrastructure to manage.- Reuse open-source connectors directly.

fabricroadmap.title: Support SSL encryption for Eventstream connector data transmission
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature allows customers to specify their own certificate for SSL encryption, enabling secure data transmission between the Eventstream streaming connector client and their source servers, such as Apache Kafka or MQTT.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Integrated Activator Alert Setup Experience
fabricroadmap.summary: The new Activator Alert feature in Eventstream allows users to set up alerts in a single step, streamlining the process. With this enhancement, customers can quickly create alerts directly within Eventstream, saving time and reducing complexity.

fabricroadmap.title: UX for viewing Eventhouse functions
fabricroadmap.summary: Public Preview: Q1 2026

fabricroadmap.title: Lakehouse Streaming Tables in the Real Time hub
fabricroadmap.summary: Lakehouse Streaming Tables bring real-time data processing and analytics to the Fabric Real Time hub, making it easier for data engineers and data scientists to discover, explore, and act on streaming data - all in one central location. With seamless integration to Spark and AI Skills, users can filter, open, and endorse streaming tables, and launch advanced analytics experiences. This feature is designed to boost engagement and productivity by providing instant access to continuously updated data, supporting rapid insights and decision-making for modern data teams.

fabricroadmap.title: Outbound access protection for Azure and Fabric Events
fabricroadmap.summary: Outbound Access Protection (OAP) in Microsoft Fabric restricts outbound connectivity from a workspace to external destinations unless explicitly allowed by administrators, helping prevent data exfiltration and enforce security policies.

fabricroadmap.title: Outbound access protection for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Outbound Access Protection (OAP) in Microsoft Fabric restricts outbound connectivity from a workspace to external destinations unless explicitly allowed by administrators, helping prevent data exfiltration and enforce security policies.

fabricroadmap.title: Fabric IQ ontology as operations agent source
fabricroadmap.summary: Operations agents will be able to use the semantic information in the Fabric IQ ontology as a knowledge source, monitoring the entities and data and taking actions accordingly.

fabricroadmap.title: Better feedback on OA playbook problems
fabricroadmap.summary: When you give operations agents instructions and create its rules and playbook, it gives feedback when properties couldn't be grounded with data actions couldn't be grounded rule conditions were detected that are unsupported couldn't detect any rule/condition duplicate Id columns detectedThis helps you tailor your goals and instructions so the agent learns how you want it to operate.

fabricroadmap.title: Activator as a publisher of Business Events
fabricroadmap.summary: Public Preview: Q2 2026

fabricroadmap.title: Analyze Business Events in Eventhouse
fabricroadmap.summary: Route and analyze Fabric Business Events in Eventhouse for real-time querying and analytics.

fabricroadmap.title: Secure Fabric Eventstreams with customer-managed keys
fabricroadmap.summary: Apply Fabric workspace customer managed keys to Eventstreams to add an extra layer of encryption for data at rest. When CMK is enabled for a workspace, Eventstreams automatically use the workspace key configuration via Azure Key Vault, including key rotation and revocation handling.

fabricroadmap.title: Variable Library support for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now integrates with the Fabric Variable Library, so configurations can reference workspace variables. This makes Eventstream definitions portable across development, test, and production workspaces.With this capability, you can:- Reference workspace variables for connection identifiers and item references.- Reuse a single Eventstream definition across environments by swapping variable values.- Manage configuration centrally in the variable library instead of editing each item.

fabricroadmap.title: DeltaFlow: Seamless stream processing of Database CDC Feeds
fabricroadmap.summary: DeltaFlow is an enhancement to Eventstreams that simplifies real-time analytics on Change Data Capture (CDC) feeds. fabricroadmap.title: Enable stream processing and real-time analytics on Mirror DB change feeds
fabricroadmap.summary: Mirror DB integration with Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric lets organizations track and process updates to their Mirrored data sources like Azure SQL, Mirroed Snowflake and others. By enabling change feeds on these mirrored datasets, users can quickly build event-driven and AI-powered applications—like dashboards and alerts—without complex setup or deep knowlege of Apache Spark. This streamlined approach delivers instant insights and automation, helping businesses respond to evolving data in real time.

fabricroadmap.title: Unify batch & streaming data platforms with CopyJob & Real-Time Intelligence
fabricroadmap.summary: The integration of Real-Time Intelligence with CopyJob in Microsoft Fabric empowers organizations to stream incremental updates from traditionally “batch” data sources directly into Eventstreams. Simultaneously, users can ingest data from streaming sources into any CopyJob destination that supports incremental updates. This unified experience makes it easy to build hybrid data platforms that combine batch and streaming assets. fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Observability
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream Observability is a Fabric feature that integrates Eventstream metrics into Workspace Monitoring, enabling users to gain actionable insights into their Eventstream health and performance metrics. Once enabled in Workspace Settings, Eventstream metrics will be automatically emitted into the Eventhouse database, allowing contributors to easily query, analyze, and visualize performance and diagnostic data.

fabricroadmap.title: Pause /Resume Derived Stream in Eventstream GA
fabricroadmap.summary: A feature that lets you temporarily stop and later restart the flow of a derived (transformed or routed) stream within Eventstream.

fabricroadmap.title: Route Azure Monitor Diagnostic Logs to Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: This integration simplifies the discovery of Azure resource diagnostic logs in Fabric RTI, and automatic creation of Eventstream operators, allowing users to focus more on analysis and less on setup. User can directly feed Azure diagnostic logs into Fabric without any coding, perform comprehensive analysis by combining diagnostic logs with other data sources and gain operational insights that enhance decision-making capabilities.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream connector: MongoDB CDC
fabricroadmap.summary: The MongoDB CDC connector for Eventstream captures database changes from any MongoDB deployment, including MongoDB Atlas and self-managed instances on other cloud providers. These change events are streamed into Eventstream for real-time processing and analysis.

fabricroadmap.title: Workspace Private Link for Eventstream’s Select Sources & Destinations
fabricroadmap.summary: Private Link enables secure, private connectivity between your virtual network and Microsoft Fabric, eliminating exposure to the public internet. With Eventstream’s integration with Workspace Private Link, you gain granular access control at the workspace level enhancing data security by minimizing the risk of unauthorized access and potential data breaches.

fabricroadmap.title: Schema registry for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Schema registry brings centralized schema management to Fabric Real-Time Intelligence, helping teams enforce data quality across streaming pipelines. It validates incoming events against registered schemas so downstream consumers receive consistent, well-formed data.With this capability, you can:- Register and manage schemas centrally for streaming data.- Validate events against schemas to enforce data quality.- Simplify integration across producers and consumers with shared schemas.

fabricroadmap.title: Improved Eventstream experience for non-schematized events
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now can distinguishes between different event shapes, making it easier to process and route to destination. You can design separate transformation paths for each shape with greater flexibility.With this capability, you can:- Identify distinct event shapes for the same Eventstream.- Build separate transformation paths for each shape.- Process complex, multi-shape data easily.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream SQL Operator GA
fabricroadmap.summary: The SQL Operator integrated within Evenstreams enhances the existing transformation capabilities of Eventstream by enabling users to define their own data transformation rules, facilitating the handling of advanced transformation scenarios with familiar SQL syntax.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Managed Private Endpoint Support for Azure Event Hubs & IoT Hub Sources GA
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream integration with Managed Private Endpoint for Azure EH and IoT Hub sourcesManaged Private Endpoint is a network security feature of the Fabric platform that allows Fabric items to securely access data sources behind a firewall or not accessible from the public internet. By integrating Eventstream with the Managed Private Endpoint, allowing you to securely connect to your Azure resources within a private network.

fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream source: Event Grid namespace: MQTT topic and normal topic

fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream streaming connector source: real-time weather data

fabricroadmap.title: MQTT broker source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now offers a generally available MQTT broker source connector, enabling ingestion from MQTT-based devices and brokers. MQTT is common in Internet of Things scenarios, and this connector brings that telemetry into Microsoft Fabric for real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to MQTT brokers and devices.- Stream device telemetry into Fabric destinations.- Process and route MQTT events with no-code operators or SQL operators.

fabricroadmap.title: Entra ID authentication support for custom endpoint in Eventstream GA
fabricroadmap.summary: The Custom Endpoint feature supports Entra ID authentication for both pushing and pulling data to and from Eventstream. For GA, we are enabling the Viewer role to pull data from custom endpoints.

fabricroadmap.title: Solace PubSub+ source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now provides a Solace PubSub+ source connector, letting you stream events from Solace event brokers into Microsoft Fabric. This adds support for a popular enterprise messaging platform for real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to Solace PubSub+ brokers.- Stream broker events into Fabric destinations.- Process Solace data with no-code operators and SQL operator.

fabricroadmap.title: Capacity Operation Events
fabricroadmap.summary: Public preview of Capacity Operation events to track Fabric capacity operations such as scale, pause, and resume.

fabricroadmap.title: Workspace scope for Job Events
fabricroadmap.summary: Subscribe to Fabric Job Events at the workspace scope to monitor job activity across an entire workspace.

fabricroadmap.title: show Throttling events of eventhouse at Eventhouse WS monitoring
fabricroadmap.summary: Quickly identify when and where throttling is occurring across your Eventhouse system. This feature highlights recent throttling events, helping you diagnose performance bottlenecks and take corrective action before they impact users.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventhouse: Reference Accelerated Shortcuts in Update Policy
fabricroadmap.summary: We are expanding update policies in Eventhouse to support referencing shortcuts aka. external tables backed by the Query Acceleration Policy (QAP) in Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence. With this update, you can build update policies that references or joins data directly from OneLake delta table and other supported storage locations.With this capability, you can:- Build richer transformations that join streaming data with reference data stored in OneLake, lakehouses, or external storage.

fabricroadmap.title: Root Cause Analysis in Operations Agent
fabricroadmap.summary: We are adding root cause analysis and investigate capabilities to the Operations Agent in Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence. With this update, when an anomaly or alert fires, the Operations Agent helps you understand why it happened by automatically correlating signals across your operational data and surfacing the most likely causal factors.With this capability, you can:- Move from "an alert fired" to "this is why it fired" without manually pivoting across dashboards and queries.- Correlate metrics, logs, and related entities to find contributing factors and time-ali

fabricroadmap.title: Analytics ready for database change capture CDC data in Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now makes change data capture (CDC) feeds analytics ready by automatically turning raw change events into structured tables. Developers and analysts can work with change data as if it were regular tables, without interpreting complex CDC semantics. This speeds the development of operational dashboards, event-driven applications, and real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Convert raw change events into tables that match the source schema.- Build dashboards and event-driven applications on change data quickly.- React to source changes instantly with minimal setup and mai

fabricroadmap.title: Stream processing for Mirrored Database change feeds in Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now streams change feed updates from Fabric Mirrored Databases, so you can run real-time analytics on operational data without affecting source systems. It supports Mirrored Database sources that expose Delta change feeds.With this capability, you can:- Stream change feed updates from Mirrored Databases into Eventstream.- Build dashboards, alerts, and automated actions with no-code and SQL tools.- Build event driven applications with change data feed.

fabricroadmap.title: Easily use Spark Structured Streaming with Fabric Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now integrates with Fabric Spark, letting data engineers and scientists consume and process stream data in notebooks and Spark jobs. This unifies real-time intelligence with Spark in a single end-to-end experience.With this capability, you can:- Discover and consume Eventstream data directly from Fabric notebooks.- Process streaming data with Spark Structured Streaming jobs.- Build real-time analytics and AI applications on live event data.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream connector: Cribl
fabricroadmap.summary: The Cribl source for Eventstream allows you to stream data from Cribl Stream into Fabric Eventstream. You can add Cribl as a source to your eventstream to capture, transform, and route real-time events to various destinations in Fabric.

fabricroadmap.title: Bring your own Eventhub to Fabric Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: You can now shortcut an existing Azure Event Hub as a fully featured Eventstream, bringing your own hub into Fabric without rebuilding pipelines. The shortcut stream behaves like a native Eventstream, including processing and routing.With this capability, you can:- Connect an existing Event Hub to Fabric as an Eventstream.- Process shortcut hub data with Eventstream operators.- Route events to Fabric destinations without recreating sources.

fabricroadmap.title: Activator alerts and rules on top of Data Warehouse queries
fabricroadmap.summary: Integrate Activator with Data Warehouse allowing alerting on top of business data quries as well as meta data and perf data.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventhouse Monitoring
fabricroadmap.summary: Access Eventhouse logs and metrics to fine tune performance, troubleshoot issues and identify anomalies. The Eventhouse will report on Query logs, Ingestion metrics, and Ingestion failure events. The Eventhouse event and metric logs will be stored in a read only KQL database. Users will be able to analyze the events using KQL Querysets and Real time Dashboards.

fabricroadmap.title: Easily use Spark Structured Streaming with Fabric Eventstreams
fabricroadmap.summary: Easily discover, connect to and process streaming data in Eventstreams using Fabric Notebooks and Spark Structured Streaming. Use auto-generated PySpark code, data preview and other Notebook features to write new Spark streaming code faster than ever before.

fabricroadmap.title: RTD Live Update feature
fabricroadmap.summary: The goal of this work is to make real-time dashboards smarter and more cost-efficient by: Refreshing only when new data is ingested in the underlying sources, using lightweight detection queries based on ingestion_time(). Reducing redundant queries and system load while ensuring users always see up-to-date insights when they open or monitor a dashboard. Providing a seamless fallback for data sources/tables that do not support ingestion_time().

fabricroadmap.title: RTD time series visualization
fabricroadmap.summary: Public Preview: Q2 2026

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Integrated Activator Alert Setup Experience
fabricroadmap.summary: The new Activator Alert feature in Eventstream allows users to set up alerts in a single step, streamlining the process. With this enhancement, customers can quickly create alerts directly within Eventstream, saving time and reducing complexity.

fabricroadmap.title: Eventstream Event Metadata Propagation
fabricroadmap.summary: This feature enables Eventstream to propagate and expose source system metadata (such as headers and properties) alongside event data, allowing users to access, route, and process events using that metadata across connectors and query experiences

fabricroadmap.title: Workspace Private Links for Eventstream Custom Endpoint
fabricroadmap.summary: Private Links enable secure, private connectivity between your virtual network and Microsoft Fabric, eliminating exposure to the public internet. fabricroadmap.title: Pagination support for the Eventstream HTTP connector

fabricroadmap.title: OAuth support for the Eventstream HTTP connector
fabricroadmap.summary: The Eventstream HTTP connector now supports OAuth authentication for external API sources. This lets you stream data from third-party providers that require token-based access, using a secure, standard authentication flow.With this capability, you can:- Authenticate to external APIs with OAuth tokens.- Stream data securely from providers that require token-based access.- Refresh tokens automatically for continuous ingestion.

fabricroadmap.summary: Azure blob storage events enablement with Tenant Private Links

fabricroadmap.title: Dynamic thresholds in Activator rules
fabricroadmap.summary: Adds support for dynamic thresholding in Activator rules, enabling users to define conditions based on changing baselines rather than static values. Use this enhancement when threshold limits vary across objects or can change over time. Example scenarios include: - Buildings with different maximum allowed temperatures. - Equipment fleets where each asset has a unique operating limit. - Customer-level alerting where each customer has a configured threshold.

fabricroadmap.title: Activator: Stateful conditions in event-based triggers
fabricroadmap.summary: Activator now supports creating stateful rules directly from events, without the need to create an object. This is useful when your events represent the state of a single object. It means you can avoid having to create an object for your events.

fabricroadmap.title: Lakehouse Delta table change feed connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now reads change records directly from change-enabled Delta tables in a Lakehouse and streams them in real time. fabricroadmap.title: Unified GetEvents for Fabric RTI
fabricroadmap.summary: Building a unified GetEvents experience across Fabric Real-Time Intelligence (RTI), ensuring consistency across Eventstream, Real-Time Hub, KQL/Eventhouse, Activator, Notebook, and Lakehouse. fabricroadmap.title: JDBC source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream offers a JDBC source connector, letting you stream from databases that expose a JDBC interface.With this capability, you can:- Stream data from JDBC-compatible databases into Eventstream.- Customize the open-source connector for specialized sources.

fabricroadmap.title: Apache Kafka source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now offers a fully supported Apache Kafka source connector, letting you bring events from Kafka topics into Microsoft Fabric for real-time analytics. fabricroadmap.title: Salesforce change data capture source connector
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now provides a Salesforce change data capture source connector, streaming record changes from Salesforce into Microsoft Fabric. fabricroadmap.title: Salesforce platform events source connector
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now provides a Salesforce platform events source connector, bringing real-time business events from Salesforce into Microsoft Fabric. This complements change data capture by streaming custom and standard platform events.With this capability, you can:- Stream Salesforce platform events into Eventstream.- Trigger real-time analytics and actions on business events.- Route platform events to Fabric destinations.

fabricroadmap.title: JMS Eventstream connector
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream now supports a Java Message Service source connector, extending coverage to another widely used message broker type. fabricroadmap.title: Azure Data Explorer source connector for Eventstream
fabricroadmap.summary: The Azure Data Explorer source connector for Eventstream extends ingestion limits and adds streaming from a custom query, so you can bring Azure Data Explorer data into Microsoft Fabric for further real-time processing.With this capability, you can:- Stream data from Azure Data Explorer into Eventstream.- Use a custom query to select the data you ingest.- Route results to Fabric destinations for downstream analytics.

fabricroadmap.title: On-premises and virtual network connectivity for Eventstream connectors
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream connectors can now reach data sources that sit on-premises or inside a private virtual network. fabricroadmap.title: Custom CA and mutual TLS support for Eventstream connectors
fabricroadmap.summary: Eventstream messaging connectors now support custom certificate authorities and mutual TLS authentication. fabricroadmap.title: Workspace identity auth support for Eventstream Event hub source

fabricroadmap.title: Business events
fabricroadmap.summary: A business event is an event that is immediately actionable and typically triggers a specific handler or response. These events are discreet, meaning they report a point-in-time occurrence such as a package being shipped or an order being received. Business events are focused on the type of event and the fact that an event has occurred, rather than the data itself. Business events are intended to be used to enable extensibility in applications in Fabric by allowing other Fabric items to react to these events and perform actions based on them.
